description: This file defines a React component 'Block' used in the FreeCodeCamp curriculum interface. It manages rendering different layouts for challenge blocks, handles user interactions, and connects to Redux state for challenge progress and expansion state.

classes.name: Block
classes.description: React component representing a curriculum challenge block with various layouts and interactions.

methods.name: handleBlockClick
methods.description: Handles toggling the expansion of the challenge block, plays a toggle tone.

methods.name: handleChallengeClick
methods.description: Updates browser history with the challenge's dashed name when a challenge is clicked.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the block component with different layouts based on challenge data and props.
